query:
SELECT entity_id
            FROM entity_properties
            WHERE property_definition_id = '00000001-0000-0000-0000-000000000014'
              AND entity_type = 'TASK'
              AND values -> 'value' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                  'entity_id', $1::text, 'entity_type', 'INITIATIVE'
              ))
            ORDER BY entity_id
